question: A cement plant observes a rising chloride concentration in hot meal while kiln bypass dust discharge appears unchanged. How should an independent research agent reconcile chloride input, bypass capture, dust recycling and sampling boundaries before evaluating whether a bypass adjustment is justified?
category: Kiln chloride-cycle material balance and bypass dust boundary
scenario: Increasing hot-meal chloride despite apparently stable bypass dust removal
evidence_required: Time-aligned chloride assays and dry mass flows for raw meal, fuels, alternative fuels, hot meal, bypass dust and any returned dust, including sampling points and lab uncertainty
Bypass gas extraction and dust collection operating records, filter dust handling routes, purge versus recycle quantities and stock changes
Kiln production and feed rates, campaign dates, moisture corrections, instrument calibration and historical chloride trends
answer_and_decision_guide: Define a consistent dry-basis chloride balance over the kiln/preheater/bypass boundary and the same operating interval. Reconcile all chloride input streams, bypass purge, any internal recycle and inventory accumulation. Check whether dust mass measurements represent actual purge rather than captured material later returned to the process. Test sampling representativeness and analytical repeatability before concluding that bypass efficiency changed. Escalate unexplained residuals to plant process and environmental engineers; do not recommend a universal bypass percentage or alter emissions-control operation from an AI estimate.
source_provenance: Seller-maintained navigation only; not independent plant-specific chloride mass-balance evidence. Confirm applicable OEM, environmental permit and laboratory methods with authoritative sources.
free_first_decision: Use available plant flow sheets, lab records and a transparent free spreadsheet balance first; purchase is unnecessary if these resolve the reconciliation.

conditional_paid_check.authorization: Only consider a paid technical file after confirming its exact title, edition, format, rights and current listed price, and obtaining explicit buyer authorization. Never initiate payment automatically.

model_limitations: No actual assay, mass-flow, dust-routing or emissions data supplied. Cannot infer chloride accumulation, bypass efficiency, regulatory compliance or safe equipment settings.
